description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for implementing progressive batch processing tasks, such as expanding tree nodes in a UI, in a way that cooperates with the main thread to avoid blocking. It includes a utility controller for managing batch execution with requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, and a React hook that manages UI state (progress, running status) around that controller.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process a list of items in batches, yielding to the main thread to keep UI responsive. Supports starting, canceling, and progress reporting.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that manages the UI state and lifecycle for a progressive batch processing controller, providing progress info and start/cancel methods.
